flavor.zh: 大航海时代的起点,特茹河口帆影如林。
flavor.en: Cradle of the Age of Discovery, its Tagus anchorage thick with sails.

flavor.zh: 瓜达尔基维尔河上的白银之城,船坞与货栈昼夜不歇。
flavor.en: City of silver on the Guadalquivir, its docks and warehouses never idle.

flavor.zh: 橙树林环绕的黎凡特港,丝绸与陶器在码头上成捆堆积。
flavor.en: A Levantine harbor ringed with orange groves, its quays stacked with silk and pottery.

flavor.zh: 加泰罗尼亚的商港,棉布与羊毛在此装船北运。
flavor.en: Catalonia's merchant port, where cotton and wool are loaded for the north.

flavor.zh: 普罗旺斯的门户,帆船载着葡萄酒与香水驶向东方。
flavor.en: Gateway to Provence, its ships bearing wine and perfume eastward.

flavor.zh: 加龙河口的葡萄酒港,英国商人的酒桶常年不断。
flavor.en: The wine port of the Garonne, forever loading casks for English merchants.

flavor.zh: 泰晤士河畔的贸易巨城,羊毛与布匹堆满河岸。
flavor.en: A trading giant on the Thames, its banks piled with wool and cloth.

flavor.zh: 运河纵横的商都,玻璃与奶酪从这里流向全欧。
flavor.en: A merchant capital of canals, sending glass and cheese across Europe.

flavor.zh: 斯海尔德河上的集市之城,各国商船在此交汇。
flavor.en: A fair city on the Scheldt where merchants of every nation meet.

flavor.zh: 北海边的汉萨旧港,鱼干与琥珀是码头的常客。
flavor.en: An old Hanse port by the North Sea, its quays known for fish and amber.

flavor.zh: 利古里亚海岸的银行家之港,橄榄油与棉布南来北往。
flavor.en: A bankers' harbor on the Ligurian coast, trading oil and cotton.

flavor.zh: 维苏威脚下的繁忙港口,酒桶与谷袋堆满码头。
flavor.en: A busy port beneath Vesuvius, its wharves heaped with casks and grain.

flavor.zh: 西西里西岸的粮仓,小麦由这里运往地中海各地。
flavor.en: The granary of western Sicily, shipping wheat across the Mediterranean.

flavor.zh: 锡拉库萨的咸水田与麦田,靠盐与谷物为生。
flavor.en: Syracuse lives on its salt pans and wheat fields by the sea.

flavor.zh: 撒丁岛南端的盐港,皮革与盐在此上船。
flavor.en: A salt port at the southern tip of Sardinia, loading leather and brine.

flavor.zh: 马耳他骑士团筑起的堡垒港,棉布在此交易。
flavor.en: A fortress harbor built by the Knights of Malta, trading in cotton cloth.

flavor.zh: 亚得里亚海的女王,商栈与运河之城。
flavor.en: Queen of the Adriatic, city of canals and counting-houses.

flavor.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克的商船之港,木材与皮革堆满码头。
flavor.en: The merchant port of Dubrovnik, its quays stacked with timber and leather.

flavor.zh: 雅典港内橄榄与陶器并陈,古代的石柱仍望着海。
flavor.en: Olive oil and pottery fill the harbor, while ancient columns still face the sea.

flavor.zh: 克里特岛上的威尼斯遗港,酒与橄榄油源源而出。
flavor.en: A Venetian-built port on Crete, pouring out wine and olive oil.

flavor.zh: 塞浦路斯南岸的铜与糖之港,季风带来东方货物。
flavor.en: A port of copper and sugar on Cyprus, where monsoons bring eastern wares.

flavor.zh: 爱琴海东岸的大集市,地毯在码头上铺了一地。
flavor.en: A great market on the Aegean coast, carpets spread along the quay.

flavor.zh: 金角湾畔的帝国首都,博斯普鲁斯的风带来两洲的货物。
flavor.en: Imperial capital of the Golden Horn, where Bosphorus winds carry goods from two continents.

flavor.zh: 黎凡特海岸的丝绸港,山地木材随之而下。
flavor.en: A silk port on the Levantine coast, with mountain timber floated down to the quay.

flavor.zh: 尼罗河口的古老商都,谷物与糖在灯塔下装船。
flavor.en: An ancient emporium at the Nile's mouth, loading grain and sugar beneath the lighthouse.

flavor.zh: 北非海岸的停泊地,皮革与盐是这里的生意。
flavor.en: A roadstead on the North African coast, trading leather and salt.

flavor.zh: 突尼斯湖畔的港城,橄榄油与皮革由此北运。
flavor.en: A harbor town by the Tunis lake, sending oil and leather north.

flavor.zh: 巴巴里海岸的白色港城,皮革与羊毛堆满码头。
flavor.en: The white port of the Barbary coast, its quays heaped with leather and wool.

flavor.zh: 直布罗陀门户上的葡属要塞。
flavor.en: A Portuguese stronghold guarding the gates of Gibraltar.

flavor.zh: 大西洋边缘的糖与酒之岛,地图最西端的锚地。
flavor.en: An Atlantic isle of sugar and wine, the westernmost anchorage on the chart.

flavor.zh: 加勒比海上的良港,蔗糖与烟草在此装船。
flavor.en: A fine Caribbean haven where sugar and tobacco go aboard.

flavor.zh: 白银之路的东大门,骡队在此与船队相会。
flavor.en: The silver road's eastern gate, where mule trains meet the fleet.

flavor.zh: 环礁之后的设防宝库港,领航员对每条水道铭记于心。
flavor.en: A walled treasure port behind reefs the pilots know by heart.

flavor.zh: 闷热多雨的集市,宝船队每年在此装货一次。
flavor.en: A hot, rain-soaked fair where the treasure fleet loads once a year.

flavor.zh: 卡亚俄锚地在雾后为这座王者之城服务。
flavor.en: Callao's roadstead serves the City of Kings from behind the fog.

flavor.zh: 无垠草原的皮革与油脂在这座泥泞河港装船。
flavor.en: Hides and tallow from the endless pampas load at this muddy river port.

flavor.zh: 扼守加勒比通道的设防锚地。
flavor.en: A fortified anchorage guarding the passage into the Caribbean.

flavor.zh: 新大陆上最古老的西班牙治所。
flavor.en: The oldest seat of Spanish rule in the new world.

flavor.zh: 马尼拉大帆船在此以中国丝绸交换墨西哥白银。
flavor.en: Where the Manila galleon trades Chinese silk for Mexican silver.

flavor.zh: 狭窄的地峡,两洋几乎在此相握。
flavor.en: The narrow isthmus where two oceans nearly shake hands.

flavor.zh: 陡坡之下的多风海湾,为太平洋航程补给。
flavor.en: A windswept bay under steep hills, provisioning the Pacific run.

flavor.zh: 赤道上的可可与造船河港。
flavor.en: A river port of cacao and shipwrights on the equator.

flavor.zh: 万圣湾,制糖作坊靠贩奴船维持。
flavor.en: The Bay of All Saints, its sugar mills fed by slave ships.

flavor.zh: 群山环抱的海湾,船队可安全下锚。
flavor.en: A jaw of mountains around a bay the fleet can anchor in safely.

flavor.zh: 礁石庇护着糖海岸最繁忙的码头。
flavor.en: Reefs shelter the sugar coast's busiest landing.

flavor.zh: 通往大河与香料森林的门户。
flavor.en: The gateway to the great river and its spice-laden forests.

flavor.zh: 寒冷深湾里的鳕鱼、木材与倔强的商人。
flavor.en: Cod, timber and stubborn merchants on a cold deep bay.

flavor.zh: 河口处的避风良港,是通往内地的水路起点。
flavor.en: A sheltered harbour at the mouth of a river road into the interior.

flavor.zh: 泥河上的烟草码头,除了土地什么都缺。
flavor.en: A tobacco landing on a muddy river, short of everything but land.

flavor.zh: 稻米与靛蓝的驳船在此与远洋贸易相会。
flavor.en: Rice and indigo barges meet the ocean trade here.

flavor.zh: 大浅滩的腌鱼滩,每年夏天都挤满人。
flavor.en: The Grand Banks' curing beaches, busy every summer.

flavor.zh: 峭壁上的毛皮站,俯瞰渐窄的河流。
flavor.en: A cliff-top fur post above the narrowing river.

flavor.zh: 干旱小岛,盐田与自由港招来万国旗。
flavor.en: A dry island whose salt pans and free port draw every flag.

flavor.zh: 种植园河流缓缓甜甜地流向大海。
flavor.en: Plantation rivers running slow and sweet to the sea.

flavor.zh: 黄金海岸上的城堡,贸易以人命计量。
flavor.en: A castle on the Gold Coast, its trade measured in human lives.

flavor.zh: 刚果以南的炎热海湾,通往内地集市的入口。
flavor.en: A hot bay south of the Congo, gateway to the interior fairs.

flavor.zh: 季风帆船与葡萄牙代理人的岛屿港口。
flavor.en: An island port of monsoon dhows and Portuguese factors.

flavor.zh: 珊瑚岛港,扼守斯瓦希里海岸。
flavor.en: A coral island harbour commanding the Swahili coast.

flavor.zh: 桌山之下,为印度航程供给的菜园。
flavor.en: A table-topped mountain and a garden for the Indies run.

flavor.zh: 摩洛哥大西洋岸的陶器与盐港。
flavor.en: A pottery and salt port on the Atlantic edge of Morocco.

flavor.zh: 沙漠边缘的河口贸易站。
flavor.en: A river-mouth trading post at the edge of the desert.

flavor.zh: 浪花拍岸的码头,独木舟驶向大船。
flavor.en: A surf-beaten landing where canoes run out to the ships.

flavor.zh: 总督驻地,棕榈海岸上方的白色教堂。
flavor.en: The Viceroy's seat, its churches white above the palm coast.

flavor.zh: 胡椒之路的西端,挤满阿拉伯帆船。
flavor.en: The pepper road's western terminus, crowded with Arab dhows.

flavor.zh: 中国渔网与香料仓库交错的水乡港。
flavor.en: A backwater of Chinese nets and spice warehouses.

flavor.zh: 七岛相连的天然深水港。
flavor.en: Seven islands joined into one deep natural harbour.

flavor.zh: 莫卧儿帝国往来红海最繁忙的码头。
flavor.en: The Mughal empire's busiest quay for the Red Sea run.

flavor.zh: 锡兰背风面的肉桂锚地。
flavor.en: A cinnamon roadstead on the lee of Ceylon.

flavor.zh: 科罗曼德海岸上笔直街道的方格小城。
flavor.en: A grid of straight streets on the Coromandel coast.

flavor.zh: 光秃的黑山之后,采珠船聚集的港湾。
flavor.en: Bare black hills behind a harbour of pearling dhows.

flavor.zh: 两河合一处的椰枣园。
flavor.en: The date gardens where the twin rivers become one.

flavor.zh: 波斯湾的税关,炎热而堆满账册。
flavor.en: The Persian Gulf's customs house, hot and full of ledgers.

flavor.zh: 光秃火山丘下的火山口港湾。
flavor.en: A crater harbour under bare volcanic hills.

flavor.zh: 红海的朝圣之门,道路被尘土染白。
flavor.en: The Red Sea's pilgrim gate, its roads white with dust.

flavor.zh: 苏丹贸易的珊瑚石港,已半为泥沙所淤。
flavor.en: A coral-built port of the Sudan trade, half silted already.

flavor.zh: 贝纳迪尔海岸上白墙环绕的锚地。
flavor.en: A white-walled roadstead on the Benadir coast.

flavor.zh: 海峡的税关,每支季风船队都必须经过。
flavor.en: The strait's toll-house, where every monsoon fleet must pass.

flavor.zh: 运河、货栈与公司的东方首府。
flavor.en: Canals, warehouses and the Company's eastern capital.

flavor.zh: 布吉商人与公司船只的交汇之地。
flavor.en: A meeting point of Bugis traders and Company ships.

flavor.zh: 丁香之岛,由星形要塞守卫。
flavor.en: The clove island, guarded by a star fort.

flavor.zh: 设防之城,白银大帆船与中国帆船在此相会。
flavor.en: A walled city where the silver galleon meets Chinese junks.

flavor.zh: 河口半岛上的教堂与货栈。
flavor.en: A peninsula of churches and godowns at the river's mouth.

flavor.zh: 大河之城,外国船只只能在黄埔下锚。
flavor.en: The great river city where foreign ships may anchor only at Whampoa.

flavor.zh: 内湾港,一座小岛承载全部对外贸易。
flavor.en: A landlocked bay where one small island carries all foreign trade.

flavor.zh: 全国的米市,驳船拥挤。
flavor.en: The rice market of the realm, thick with barges.

flavor.zh: 绿岛沙洲上的要塞,岛上多鹿与甘蔗。
flavor.en: A sandbar fort off a green island of deer and sugar.

flavor.zh: 马来渔人与中国商人共处的港口。
flavor.en: A Malay port of fishermen and Chinese traders.

flavor.zh: 苏丹宫殿下高脚屋组成的水上之城。
flavor.en: A water town of stilt houses under the Sultan's palace.

flavor.zh: 生长世界丁香的火山岛。
flavor.en: A volcano island that grows the world's cloves.

flavor.zh: 季风之路尽头的干旱檀木岛。
flavor.en: A dry, sandalwood island at the end of the monsoon road.

flavor.zh: 鲨鱼湾红崖下的锚地，1616年荷兰东印度船在此登岸取水补盐。
flavor.en: Anchorage under Shark Bay's red cliffs, where a Dutch East-Indiaman landed in 1616 to water and salt.

flavor.zh: 河都下游的港口,盛产柚木。
flavor.en: A river capital's downstream port, rich in teak.

flavor.zh: 宝船队在大西洋一侧的母港锚地。
flavor.en: The treasure fleet's home roadstead on the Atlantic side.

flavor.zh: 梯田葡萄园直落花岗岩河口。
flavor.en: Terraced vineyards falling to a granite river mouth.

flavor.zh: 防波堤后的海湾,堆满海军物资。
flavor.en: A sound behind a breakwater, full of naval stores.

flavor.zh: 多雨的码头,堆满鳕鱼干与汉萨账册。
flavor.en: A rain-soaked quay of dried cod and Hanseatic ledgers.

flavor.zh: 波罗的海东岸的谷物与木材码头。
flavor.en: The grain and timber wharf of the Baltic's eastern shore.

flavor.zh: 群岛之城,扼守波罗的海内海。
flavor.en: A city of islands guarding the Baltic's inner sea.

flavor.zh: 哈布斯堡王朝的出海之窗,多风而繁忙。
flavor.en: The Habsburgs' window on the sea, windy and busy.

flavor.zh: 橄榄覆盖的岛屿,横跨亚得里亚海口。
flavor.en: An olive-covered island astride the Adriatic's mouth.

flavor.zh: 刺桐古港，宋元海船首航之地。
flavor.en: The old Zayton, first landfall of Song and Yuan sea traders.

flavor.zh: 甬江口帆樯林立，明州窑货由此出海。
flavor.en: Forest of masts at the Yong river mouth, where Mingzhou wares ship out.

flavor.zh: 隆庆开海后，九龙江口一枝独秀的商港。
flavor.en: After the 1567 opening of the seas, the one licensed wharf on the Jiulong estuary.

flavor.zh: 走私商人云集的双屿港，官军焚毁后余烬犹温。
flavor.en: Smugglers' haven of Shuangyu, its ashes barely cold since the imperial raid.

flavor.zh: 闽粤交界的岛澳，商盗出没其间。
flavor.en: An island anchorage between Fujian and Guangdong, haunt of merchants and pirates.

flavor.zh: 鹭岛环列的港湾，月港的外口。
flavor.en: The gull island's ringed harbor, outer gate of Yuegang.

flavor.zh: 闽江口水程尽头，省城的港口。
flavor.en: Head of the Min river's tidal water, the provincial capital's port.

flavor.zh: 瓯江口窑货与鱼盐并出。
flavor.en: The Ou river mouth ships kiln wares alongside fish and salt.

flavor.zh: 潮州柘林澳，粤东商船必泊之地。
flavor.en: Zhelin anchorage of Chaozhou prefecture, a required stop for eastern Guangdong shipping.

flavor.zh: 琼州海峡南口的黎汉互市之港。
flavor.en: On the south side of the Qiongzhou strait, market of Li and Han traders.

flavor.zh: 合浦珠场故地，北部湾畔的盐埠。
flavor.en: Old pearl grounds of Hepu, a salt station on the Gulf of Tonkin.

flavor.zh: 舟山群岛的渔港，海禁下的暗市窗口。
flavor.en: Fishing harbor of the Zhoushan isles, a window of the banned sea trade.

flavor.zh: 郑和宝船昔日启航处，今为松江棉布出海之埠。
flavor.en: Where Zheng He's treasure ships once sailed, now the outlet for Songjiang cotton cloth.

flavor.zh: 松浦氏的港町，南蛮船与唐船并泊。
flavor.en: Port town of the Matsura lords, nanban and Chinese ships moored side by side.

flavor.zh: 自治的濠环之城，缝刃与商货同富。
flavor.en: The moat-ringed self-governing city, rich in blades and merchandise alike.

flavor.zh: 萨摩外港，南蛮船最初驶入的湾口。
flavor.en: Satsuma's outer harbor, the bay where the first nanban ships entered.

flavor.zh: 遣明船故地，对唐对朝的门户。
flavor.en: Old berth of the Ming-mission ships, gateway to China and Korea.

flavor.zh: 大友宗麟的府内港，南蛮文化登岸之处。
flavor.en: Funai of the Otomo lord, landing place of nanban learning.

flavor.zh: 土佐浦戸湾，长宗我部的海门。
flavor.en: Urado bay in Tosa, the sea gate of the Chosokabe.

flavor.zh: 日本三津之一，伊势湾头的古港。
flavor.en: One of Japan's three great harbors, old port at the head of Ise bay.

flavor.zh: 朝鲜南海的要港，倭馆所在之地。
flavor.en: Key harbor of Korea's southern sea, seat of the Japanese trading house.

flavor.zh: 三浦倭馆之一，盐田与渔帆相接。
flavor.en: One of the three open ports, salt pans joining the fishing sails.

flavor.zh: 阮主开埠的会安，唐船与和船并集。
flavor.en: Faifo, opened by the Nguyen lords, where Chinese and Japanese ships gather.

flavor.zh: 万丹胡椒码头，华商英商竞市之地。
flavor.en: Pepper wharf of Banten, where Chinese and English merchants bid against each other.

flavor.zh: 詹卑河口的胡椒之国。
flavor.en: Pepper country at the mouth of the Jambi river.

flavor.zh: 旧港宣慰司故地，室利佛逝的余晖。
flavor.en: Old Palembang of the Ming commissioner, afterglow of Srivijaya.

flavor.zh: 阇婆商港，爪哇船匠聚居之地。
flavor.en: Javanese entrepot where the shipwrights of Geresik dwell.

flavor.zh: 苏禄海的珍珠之国，朝贡船曾至明廷。
flavor.en: Pearl kingdom of the Sulu sea, whose tribute ships once reached the Ming court.

flavor.zh: 吉打港，马来半岛西岸的古老锚地。
flavor.en: Kedah, the oldest anchorage on the Malay peninsula's western shore.

flavor.zh: 朱罗故都的科罗曼德尔商港。
flavor.en: Coromandel port of the old Chola capital.

flavor.zh: 戈尔康达的海门，花布与宝石并出。
flavor.en: Sea gate of Golconda, shipping painted cloth and gems.

flavor.zh: 胡格利河上的葡萄牙商站，孟加拉的绸门。
flavor.en: The Portuguese settlement on the Hughli river, Bengal's gate of silk.

flavor.zh: 勃固河口的柚木码头，德布里托的要塞。
flavor.en: Teak wharf at the Pegu river mouth, fortress of de Brito.

flavor.zh: 阿拉干海岸的葡人锚地。
flavor.en: The Portuguese anchorage on the Arakan coast.

flavor.zh: 坎贝湾头的古商港，玛瑙与花布之名。
flavor.en: Old port at the head of the Cambay gulf, famed for agates and chintz.

flavor.zh: 第乌要塞，1538 年围城的战场。
flavor.en: The fortress of Diu, battleground of the 1538 siege.

flavor.zh: 红海口的咖啡港，骆驼与帆影相接。
flavor.en: Coffee port at the Red Sea's gate, camel trains meeting the sails.

flavor.zh: 阿曼湾畔的古城，波斯航海图的常客。
flavor.en: Old city on the Gulf of Oman, a fixture in the Persian rutters.

flavor.zh: 霍尔木兹岛的要塞，扼波斯湾的咽喉。
flavor.en: Fortress on Hormuz island, hand on the throat of the Persian Gulf.

flavor.zh: 温古贾岛的香料锚地，红木输往波斯湾。
flavor.en: Anchorage of Unguja, shipping mangrove poles to the Persian Gulf.

flavor.zh: 基尔瓦古城，黄金之道的出口。
flavor.en: Old Kilwa, outlet of the gold road from Sofala.

flavor.zh: 索法拉的黄金码头，葡人堡垒守着河口。
flavor.en: Gold wharf of Sofala, the Portuguese fort watching the river mouth.

flavor.zh: 斯瓦希里石城拉穆，独桅帆船的母港。
flavor.en: The stone town of Lamu, home port of the dhows.

flavor.zh: 红海西岸的盐币之港，高原商路的入口。
flavor.en: Red Sea port of the salt-bar currency, gate of the highland trade roads.

flavor.zh: 非洲之角的古港，埃塞俄比亚商路的海口。
flavor.en: Ancient port of the Horn, sea outlet of the Ethiopian trade roads.
